description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hitthetiya-East, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820004
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels in Matara District. The content includes detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, ownership details, and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
